verses.text: The LORD is near to those who have a broken heart, and saves those who have a crushed spirit.
Why are you in despair, my soul? Why are you disturbed within me? Hope in God! For I shall still praise him for the saving help of his presence.

I waited patiently for the LORD. He turned to me, and heard my cry. He brought me up also out of a horrible pit, out of the miry clay. He set my feet on a rock, and gave me a firm place to stand. He has put a new song in my mouth, even praise to our God. Many shall see it, and fear, and shall trust in the LORD.

Hurry to answer me, LORD. My spirit fails. Don’t hide your face from me, so that I don’t become like those who go down into the pit. Cause me to hear your loving kindness in the morning, for I trust in you. Cause me to know the way in which I should walk, for I lift up my soul to you.
But you, LORD, are a shield around me, my glory, and the one who lifts up my head.
The LORD will also be a high tower for the oppressed; a high tower in times of trouble.
For you will light my lamp, LORD. My God will light up my darkness.

The LORD is my shepherd; I shall lack nothing. He makes me lie down in green pastures. He leads me beside still waters. He restores my soul. He guides me in the paths of righteousness for his name’s sake.
LORD my God, I cried to you, and you have healed me.
Have mercy on me, LORD, for I am in distress. My eye, my soul, and my body waste away with grief.
As for me, I said in my haste, “I am cut off from before your eyes.” Nevertheless you heard the voice of my petitions when I cried to you.
You are my hiding place. You will preserve me from trouble. You will surround me with songs of deliverance.
I sought the LORD, and he answered me, and delivered me from all my fears.
Lord, all my desire is before you. My groaning is not hidden from you.
As for me, I will call on God. The LORD will save me. Evening, morning, and at noon, I will cry out in distress. He will hear my voice.
From the end of the earth, I will call to you when my heart is overwhelmed. Lead me to the rock that is higher than I.

Save me, God, for the waters have come up to my neck! I sink in deep mire, where there is no foothold. I have come into deep waters, where the floods overflow me. I am weary with my crying. My throat is dry. My eyes fail looking for my God.
LORD, the God of my salvation, I have cried day and night before you. Let my prayer enter into your presence. Turn your ear to my cry.
When I said, “My foot is slipping!” Your loving kindness, LORD, held me up. In the multitude of my thoughts within me, your comforts delight my soul.
I love the LORD, because he listens to my voice, and my cries for mercy. Because he has turned his ear to me, therefore I will call on him as long as I live.
Out of my distress, I called on the LORD. The LORD answered me with freedom.
If I say, “Surely the darkness will overwhelm me. The light around me will be night,” even the darkness doesn’t hide from you, but the night shines as the day. The darkness is like light to you.
Therefore my spirit is overwhelmed within me. My heart within me is desolate. I remember the days of old. I meditate on all your doings. I contemplate the work of your hands.
Don’t you be afraid, for I am with you. Don’t be dismayed, for I am your God. I will strengthen you. Yes, I will help you. Yes, I will uphold you with the right hand of my righteousness.
He won’t break a bruised reed. He won’t quench a dimly burning wick. He will faithfully bring justice.

But now the LORD who created you, Jacob, and he who formed you, Israel, says: “Don’t be afraid, for I have redeemed you. I have called you by your name. You are mine. When you pass through the waters, I will be with you, and through the rivers, they will not overflow you. When you walk through the fire, you will not be burnt, and flame will not scorch you.”

The Lord GOD’s Spirit is on me, because the LORD has anointed me to preach good news to the humble. He has sent me to bind up the broken hearted, to proclaim liberty to the captives and release to those who are bound.

He gives power to the weak. He increases the strength of him who has no might. Even the youths faint and get weary, and the young men utterly fall; but those who wait for the LORD will renew their strength. They will mount up with wings like eagles. They will run, and not be weary. They will walk, and not faint.
Who amongst you fears the LORD and obeys the voice of his servant? He who walks in darkness and has no light, let him trust in the LORD’s name, and rely on his God.

I called on your name, LORD, out of the lowest dungeon. You heard my voice: “Don’t hide your ear from my sighing, and my cry.” You came near in the day that I called on you. You said, “Don’t be afraid.”
He said, “I called because of my affliction to the LORD. He answered me. Out of the belly of Sheol I cried. You heard my voice.”
Don’t rejoice against me, my enemy. When I fall, I will arise. When I sit in darkness, the LORD will be a light to me.

“Come to me, all you who labour and are heavily burdened, and I will give you rest. Take my yoke upon you and learn from me, for I am gentle and humble in heart; and you will find rest for your souls. For my yoke is easy, and my burden is light.”
Even to old age I am he, and even to grey hairs I will carry you. I have made, and I will bear. Yes, I will carry, and will deliver.
The thief only comes to steal, kill, and destroy. I came that they may have life, and may have it abundantly.
Don’t let your heart be troubled. Believe in God. Believe also in me.
I will not leave you orphans. I will come to you.
In the same way, the Spirit also helps our weaknesses, for we don’t know how to pray as we ought. But the Spirit himself makes intercession for us with groanings which can’t be uttered.
Who shall separate us from the love of Christ? Could oppression, or anguish, or persecution, or famine, or nakedness, or peril, or sword?

For I am persuaded that neither death, nor life, nor angels, nor principalities, nor things present, nor things to come, nor powers, nor height, nor depth, nor any other created thing will be able to separate us from God’s love which is in Christ Jesus our Lord.
You have turned my mourning into dancing for me. You have removed my sackcloth, and clothed me with gladness.
We are pressed on every side, yet not crushed; perplexed, yet not to despair; pursued, yet not forsaken; struck down, yet not destroyed.

In nothing be anxious, but in everything, by prayer and petition with thanksgiving, let your requests be made known to God. And the peace of God, which surpasses all understanding, will guard your hearts and your thoughts in Christ Jesus.

Be free from the love of money, content with such things as you have, for he has said, “I will in no way leave you, neither will I in any way forsake you.” So that with good courage we say, “The Lord is my helper. I will not fear. What can man do to me?”
Casting all your worries on him, because he cares for you.
The LORD’s angel came again the second time, and touched him, and said, “Arise and eat, because the journey is too great for you.”
The LORD himself is who goes before you. He will be with you. He will not fail you nor forsake you. Don’t be afraid. Don’t be discouraged.
But you, Lord, are a merciful and gracious God, slow to anger, and abundant in loving kindness and truth.
The LORD, your God, is amongst you, a mighty one who will save. He will rejoice over you with joy. He will calm you in his love. He will rejoice over you with singing.
But the souls of the righteous are in the hand of God, and no torment will touch them.

messages.text: Depression is an illness, not a lack of faith. Asking for help is a brave and holy thing to do.
If you have thoughts of harming yourself, please call 999 or 112 now, or tell someone near you right away.
Please talk to someone you trust today: a doctor, a counsellor, a priest, a friend or family member.
God does not love you less when you cannot feel Him. He is still here.
Elijah lay under a tree and asked to die. God sent an angel with bread and said, Rest, then eat.
Today, it is enough to do one small thing: drink water, eat a little, step into the light.
You are not lazy or weak. You are carrying something very heavy.
Jesus knew anguish in the Garden. He is with you in yours.
Even if you cannot pray, you can whisper His name. Jesus.
Darkness is not dark to God. He sees you clearly and loves you completely.
Many saints walked through deep darkness, and God brought them through. He will bring you through too.
Your feelings are not facts. Your feelings say no one cares. The truth is that God cares deeply, and so do others.
Let others carry you for a while, like the friends who lowered the paralysed man to Jesus.
Medicine, therapy and prayer can all be gifts from God. You may need more than one.
Mother Teresa felt God's absence for years and still trusted. Feelings come and go; God stays.
God's love for you is not a reward. It is a gift that cannot be taken away.
You matter. The world is better because you are in it.
Rest is not failure. Even Jesus withdrew to rest.
Try to step outside for a few minutes today. Let the sun remind you that God still makes new days.
The Psalms were written by people who knew despair. Let their words become your prayer.
God does not break a bruised reed or snuff out a smouldering wick. He is gentle with you.
When the night feels endless, remember that Christ is the Light no darkness can overcome.
Write down one thing you are grateful for, even something small. It is a seed of hope.
You do not have to earn God's love by feeling better. He loves you right now.
Talk to God the way you are. Tired words, angry words and no words are all welcome.
Your life is precious. Hold on, and let others help you hold on.
Mary, Comforter of the Afflicted, pray for us. Say it now, and let her stay with you.
Healing can be slow. Celebrate small steps; God does.
You are not alone in this. Many people of faith have struggled with depression and found help.
Try to keep one simple routine today: get up, wash your face, say one prayer.
God is near to the brokenhearted and saves the crushed in spirit.
Ask your parish if there is someone you can talk to. The Church is meant to be a family.
The Holy Spirit prays for you with groanings too deep for words.
Tomorrow is a new day, and God's mercy will be there waiting.
Picture Jesus sitting beside you, saying nothing, just staying. That is how close He is.
Do not believe the voice that says you are a burden. You are a gift.
Even small acts count: making your bed, answering a message, praying one Hail Mary.
God lifted the psalmist out of the miry pit. He can lift you, step by step.
There is no shame in taking medication or seeing a counsellor. God works through healers.
You are held in the palm of God's hand, even on the days you cannot feel it.
Receive the Eucharist when you can. Let Jesus come to you when you cannot go to Him.
The Sacrament of the Anointing of the Sick is also for those who suffer in mind. You can ask for it.
Your worth is not your productivity. You are loved simply because you are God's child.
Be patient with yourself. God is.
Some days, surviving is the victory. Thank God for today's victory.
Remember a time you felt joy. That joy can return. God has not run out of it.
Let the people who love you know how you are really doing.
Say the Jesus Prayer slowly: Lord Jesus Christ, Son of God, have mercy on me.
There is a future for you, and it is held by a loving God.
Rest tonight. You made it through today, and God was with you every moment.
